title: Check permissions policy directly for cross-origin isolated capability
body: Check permissions policy directly for cross-origin isolated capability Instead of checking "allowed to use" (which returns false when a `Document` is not yet fully active or has ceased to be fully active), check "is feature enabled in document for origin" directly on the `Window`'s associated `Document` and its origin. Also explicitly set `window`'s associated `Document` in "create a new browsing context and document" before coarsening `loadTimingInfo`'s navigation start time. Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/65475. Fixes #13287. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium (passes the new WPT) * WebKit (passes the new WPT in Safari Technology Preview) * Gecko (passes the detached-iframe `crossOriginIsolated` subtests; fails the `cross-origin-isolated` permissions policy subtest) - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/65475 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: already matches * Gecko: already matches detached-iframe behavior (pre-existing `Permissions-Policy` support tracked in https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1531012) * WebKit: already matches (passes in Safari Technology Preview) - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
